lean.statement:
{f : E → ℝ} {κ h : ℝ} {J : ℕ}
    (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (hH : ∀ z v, (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z v) v ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hJ : 2 ≤ J) (hh : 0 < h) :
    let t := fun i : Fin J => h/2*(1-Real.cos ((i : ℝ)/(J-1 : ℝ)*Real.pi))
    let ell := fun j : Fin J => Lagrange.basis Finset.univ t j
    let Λ := sSup ((fun s : ℝ => ∑ j : Fin J, |(ell j).eval s|) '' Icc 0 h)
    let ω := fun i j : Fin J => ∫ s in 0..t i, (t i-s)*(ell j).eval s
    let b := fun j : Fin J => ∫ s in 0..h, (ell j).eval s
    let c := fun j : Fin J => ∫ s in 0..h, (h-s)*(ell j).eval s
    h ^ 2 * Λ ≤ 1 →
    let a := Real.exp (-h / 2)
    let sigma := Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-h))
    let Γ := (stdGaussian E).prod (stdGaussian E)
    let P0 := fun (z ζ : E × E) => a • z.2 + sigma • ζ.1
    let Y0 := fun (z ζ : E × E) j => z.1 + t j • P0 z ζ
    let Y1 := fun (z ζ : E × E) i => Y0 z ζ i - ∑ j, ω i j • gradient f (Y0 z ζ j)
    let Φ := fun w : (E × E) × (E × E) =>
      (w.1.1 + h • P0 w.1 w.2 - ∑ j, c j • gradient f (Y1 w.1 w.2 j),
        a • (P0 w.1 w.2 - ∑ j, b j • gradient f (Y1 w.1 w.2 j)) + sigma • w.2.2)
    Measurable Φ ∧
      (∃ K : Kernel (E × E) (E × E), IsMarkovKernel K ∧
        ∀ z, K z = Γ.map (fun ζ => Φ (z, ζ))) ∧
      ∀ z z' ζ : E × E,
        let H := h⁻¹ • ∑ j, b j •
          (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin
            (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f)
              (Y1 z' ζ j + u • (Y1 z ζ j - Y1 z' ζ j))))
        let d := WithLp.toLp 2 (z.1 - z'.1, z.2 - z'.2)
        H.toLinearMap.IsSymmetric ∧
          (∀ v, (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (H v) v ∧
            inner ℝ (H v) v ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2) ∧ ‖H‖ ≤ 1 ∧
          ∃ R : WithLp 2 (E × E) →L[ℝ] WithLp 2 (E × E),
            ‖R‖ ≤ 8 * Λ * h ^ 2 ∧
            WithLp.toLp 2 ((Φ (z,ζ)).1 - (Φ (z',ζ)).1,
              (Φ (z,ζ)).2 - (Φ (z',ζ)).2) =
                d + h • WithLp.toLp 2 (z.2-z'.2, -H (z.1-z'.1)-(z.2-z'.2)) + R d
approved_definition_context: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space, endowed with its Borel measurable space. f is a real-valued map. ContDiff R 2 f means global twice continuously Frechet differentiable; fderiv R (fderiv R f) is the genuine nested second derivative. gradient f is its first derivative Riesz representative, not an independently supplied map.

Lagrange.basis gives the actual cardinal polynomial at the defined nodes; polynomial.eval is evaluation. sSup of the displayed real set is its real supremum. Integral s in a..b is ordinary Lebesgue Bochner interval integration. Fin J indexes0 through J-1.

stdGaussian E is the standard isotropic Gaussian law associated to the real Euclidean inner product. Measure.prod means independent product, Measure.map means pushforward. Kernel(E x E)(E x E) is a measurable family of measures on phase space; IsMarkovKernel means each is a probability measure. Measurable Phi is joint measurability in phase input and both noise coordinates.

continuousLinearMapOfBilin is the Riesz-represented operator of the genuine continuous bilinear form: inner(A v,w)=B(v,w). H.IsSymmetric means all-vector inner(Hv,w)=inner(v,Hw). ||H|| is the induced operator norm, not a supplied certificate.

WithLp2(E x E) is the Euclidean product vector space with norm sqrt(||x||^2+||p||^2), coordinatewise addition/scalar action. toLp2 embeds the pair into that normed copy; it does not change coordinates. R is a continuous real linear operator on that L2 phase space. R is existential inside all compared-input/noise quantifiers.
